summary: An AI robot avatar named Vani challenges viewers to replace social media scrolling with 15 minutes of daily English practice for 30 days. She highlights her role as a non-judgmental, 24/7 AI coach who corrects grammar and pronunciation privately. The ad concludes with a human presenter promoting a 1-rupee trial for the SpeakEasy app.
